C-QUICKLOOK-MDIT-BUMP.Summary: Refresh the two vendored QuickLook preview scripts to the pinned upstream releases — markdown-it 14.2.0 → 14.3.3 and Highlight.js 11.9.0 → 11.12.0 — by replacing the packaged minified resources with byte-exact upstream dist builds, recording upstream integrity notes and adding version-pinning assertions to the existing runner unit suite, with no renderer, policy, feature or npm-dependency change.
C-QUICKLOOK-MDIT-BUMP.Problem: The packaged QuickLook resources lag upstream. Current-state inspection confirms the in-file version records: mark-quicklook/Sources/PreviewExtension/Resources/markdown-it.min.js line 1 carries the banner `markdown-it 14.2.0 ... @license MIT`, and highlight.min.js carries `Highlight.js v11.9.0 (git: f47103d4f1)` plus `t.versionString="11.9.0"`. The audit's findings F-001–F-004 (linkify fixes, smartquotes/typographer fixes, multi-line definition-list fixes) are closed upstream in markdown-it 14.3.3; these are exactly the surfaces the QuickLook bootstrap enables (MarkdownRenderer.swift configures `linkify: true, typographer: true` with `html: false`). Highlight.js 11.12.0 closes the audit's aging finding F-002 on the packaged highlight engine. No exploit or preview compromise is claimed; this is a bounded maintenance refresh of vendored bytes under the accepted content boundary.
C-QUICKLOOK-MDIT-BUMP.Relationship: Bounded maintenance on the M-073 packaged resources. It modifies only vendored script bytes and version-pin assertions on top of the applied and archived C-QUICKLOOK-CONTENT-BOUNDARY (hardening boundary) and C-QUICKLOOK-SYNTAX-THEME (light palette); it does not reopen any of their decisions. Composed against the current beta-gate-wave worktree; the plan must re-verify file digests on the fresh head before approval.

Goals.Goal: mark-quicklook/Sources/PreviewExtension/Resources/markdown-it.min.js is byte-exact the upstream markdown-it 14.3.3 browser dist build (minified markdown-it.min.js from the published release), preserving its upstream MIT license banner updated to `markdown-it 14.3.3 ... @license MIT`.

mark-quicklook/Sources/PreviewExtension/Resources/highlight.min.js is byte-exact the upstream Highlight.js 11.12.0 browser bundle (common build), preserving its upstream BSD-3-Clause header updated to `Highlight.js v11.12.0` and the in-file `versionString="11.12.0"`.

Integrity notes are recorded in the change bundle: upstream versions and tags/sha256 of the exact dist artifacts adopted, and the mapping to audit findings (markdown-it 14.3.3 closes F-001–F-004; Highlight.js 11.12.0 closes aging F-002).

The existing M-073 verification stays authoritative: the complete 26-case native fail-closed matrix, the zero-observer-request invariant and the runner's byte-integrity snapshot all pass on the refreshed scripts unchanged.

Constraints.Constraint: Write scope is exactly these three paths: mark-quicklook/Sources/PreviewExtension/Resources/markdown-it.min.js, mark-quicklook/Sources/PreviewExtension/Resources/highlight.min.js, tests/renderer/quicklook-runner.test.js. The following remain byte-identical: style.css, github-dark.css (including its C-QUICKLOOK-SYNTAX-THEME provenance header referencing the 11.9.0 GitHub Light color roles — the palette is a local adaptation and is not re-derived by this change), MarkdownRenderer.swift, PreviewProvider.swift, MarkPreview.entitlements, tools/check-quicklook.mjs, mark-quicklook/MarkQuickLook.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj, package.json and every NOTICES-node.md/NOTICES-rust.md record (the vendored copies are not npm or Cargo dependencies and are not covered by those generators).

The refreshed files are the unmodified upstream dist artifacts for the pinned versions: no local patches, no re-minification, no bundler output substitution, no feature-set rebuild. The resource names, bundleResource load order (markdown-it.min then highlight.min before the nonce-gated bootstrap) and the RESOURCE_FILES list in tools/check-quicklook.mjs are unchanged.

No renderer or policy change: the embedded bootstrap options (html: false, linkify: true, typographer: true, the hljs.highlight/getLanguage callback), the per-render nonce CSP, base64 document embedding, raw-HTML stripping, escaped titles, ephemeral WKWebView store, navigation/new-window denial, embedded-raster-only image policy and the absent network-client entitlement are all preserved byte-for-byte. No new required or optional native case; all existing 26 named cases stay mandatory and unchanged.

Version-pin assertions are added to tests/renderer/quicklook-runner.test.js (the suite that already owns runner orchestration proofs): they must fail on the current 14.2.0/11.9.0 bytes (failing-first evidence) and pass only when the packaged files carry exactly the pinned upstream versions (markdown-it banner 14.3.3; highlight.js header v11.12.0 and versionString 11.12.0). No assertion may be weakened, skipped or relaxed; existing runner assertions are otherwise untouched.

package.json, package-lock.json and the npm dependency graph are out of scope: the app renderer's own markdown-it chain (node_modules, vite.config.js grouping) is a separate dependency handled by dependabot. This change touches only the vendored QuickLook copies, which are loaded as classic scripts by the Swift renderer, not imported by the app.

License records travel with the upstream bytes: the markdown-it MIT banner and the Highlight.js BSD-3-Clause header must be present and version-consistent in the refreshed files. No repo-level NOTICE file change is required or authorized by this change.

Execute sequentially against the current graph. Preserve M-073/V-M-073 ownership, the M-046 quicklook-native hosted gate role, all runner deadlines, budgets and safety assertions; no signing, version, entitlement or installation change; frozen archived bundles stay immutable.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No renderer-side markdown-it or highlight.js change: no app renderer dependency bump, no package.json/lockfile edit, no muya or vite grouping change; the npm graph is dependabot-owned.

No feature change: no new syntax languages or themes, no typography or rendering behavior tuning, no MarkdownRenderer option change, no CSP/entitlement/navigation policy change, no QuickLook UI change.
No github-dark.css or style.css change: the accepted light palette and its 11.9.0-role provenance header remain as shipped by C-QUICKLOOK-SYNTAX-THEME.

No release, tag, app-version, signing, installation, LaunchServices registration or workflow change is authorized by this change; the vendored refresh is verified through the existing unsigned fixture path only.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Vendored bytes match the upstream published releases for the pinned versions: markdown-it.min.js equals the markdown-it 14.3.3 dist markdown-it.min.js artifact and highlight.min.js equals the Highlight.js 11.12.0 published browser bundle; SHA-256 digests of the adopted artifacts are recorded in the change bundle next to the upstream release identifiers.

Failing-first evidence: the new version-pin assertions in tests/renderer/quicklook-runner.test.js fail on the unchanged 14.2.0/11.9.0 bytes and pass after the refresh; they assert the markdown-it banner version 14.3.3 and the highlight.js header/versionString 11.12.0 exactly, with no looser matching.

node tools/check-quicklook.mjs passes on the refreshed resources: compilation, all 26 mandatory native cases (including highlight, markdown, raw-content negatives, repeat-preview and both theme cases) pass, observer request count stays zero, and source/bundle SHA-256 snapshots are internally consistent with the new bytes.

License records are consistent: the refreshed markdown-it.min.js retains an `@license MIT` banner naming 14.3.3 and the refreshed highlight.min.js retains a BSD-3-Clause header naming v11.12.0; no other file's license or attribution text changed.

The unsigned MarkPreview extension build, the runner unit suite, GRACE current/target/final gates and normal commit/push/review checks pass for the final candidate; the hosted quicklook-native job (M-046-owned) stays green and required.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: xcodebuild -project mark-quicklook/MarkQuickLook.xcodeproj -target MarkPreview -configuration Debug SYMROOT="$PWD/.claude/quicklook-content-boundary/target-build/products" OBJROOT="$PWD/.claude/quicklook-content-boundary/target-build/intermediates" CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY= REGISTER_APP_WITH_LAUNCH_SERVICES=NO SKIP_INSTALL=YES build
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The plan records, before any write on the fresh head: SHA-256 of both vendored files (failing-first pinning evidence on the 14.2.0/11.9.0 bytes), then the upstream release identifiers and SHA-256 of the adopted 14.3.3/11.12.0 artifacts, and after the write re-runs the full native matrix. Byte equality with the upstream artifacts (or digests recorded from the release downloads) is the integrity proof; the native 26-case green run with zero observer requests is the behavior proof. A plan binds these before approval.

Assumptions.Assumption: The upstream markdown-it 14.3.3 dist build still exposes the same browser global consumed by the bootstrap (`window.markdownit`) and Highlight.js 11.12.0 keeps `hljs.highlight`/`hljs.getLanguage`; the unchanged native matrix proves the integration on the actual bytes.

The update mechanism is replacement from upstream release artifacts (manual vendor refresh); no dedicated refresh script exists in tools/, so provenance is established by recorded release identifiers and digests rather than a script.
Writing this draft approves no plan, implementation, apply/archive or release; drafting only proposes the pinned versions and the bounded scope.
